title: Optimality of Interleaving-Generated Linear Layers
summary: Selected hardware-friendly interleaving layers are optimal, but whether the restricted search space preserves a globally optimal layer in general and for PRIDE remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For linear layers generated by the interleaving construction, which reduces the search space while targeting the stated security and efficiency requirements, determine whether the restriction can eliminate every globally optimal linear layer so that only suboptimal solutions remain, or whether an optimal solution is still available under those requirements. Optimality is established for the selected hardware-friendly examples, but it remains unresolved in general and specifically for the linear layer constructed for PRIDE. [S1]

scope.domain: Block-cipher linear-layer design using the interleaving construction, including the linear layer for PRIDE.
assumptions: The comparison is made under the stated security and efficiency requirements.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether restricting the search space excludes every globally optimal linear layer or still permits an optimal solution, both in general and for PRIDE.

citations.label: Block Ciphers - Focus on the Linear Layer (feat. PRIDE)

progress.summary: The paper explicitly asks whether its search-space reduction excludes optimal solutions. It establishes optimality for selected hardware-friendly examples while leaving the general case and the PRIDE linear layer unresolved.
citation_labels: Martin R. Albrecht et al., Block Ciphers - Focus on the Linear Layer (feat. PRIDE)
